title: Outside request
description: What crosses from the sandboxed part to the outside part: a request to perform one declared outside operation for one identified transaction (REQ-MDL-8). It names no destination and no secret: which destinations and secrets the operation uses is fixed by the declaration, so the sandboxed part can neither aim the call elsewhere nor ask for a secret (REQ-MDL-6, REQ-MDL-7).

transaction.description: The transaction the call is for, the one the provider-role operation being computed names.

operation.description: The name of an outside operation the module declares.

arguments.description: The operation's arguments, computed by the sandboxed part. Empty if none.
